title: Radii of Starlikeness of Spirallike Functions
summary: A normalized analytic function $f$ defined on the unit disk $\mathbb{D}$ is called $α$-spirallike if $f(\mathbb{D})$ is an $α$-spirallike domain, that is, for every $z\in f(\mathbb{D})$, the $α$-spiral $ze^{-e^{iα}t}$, $t\ge0$, is contained in $f(\mathbb{D})$, or equivalently, if $\operatorname{Re}\!\left(e^{iα} {zf'(z)}/{f(z)}\right)>0$ for all $z\in \mathbb{D}$. The 0-spirallike functions are the usual starlike functions.
